item.content:encoded: Just my two cents but what I think what this item is missing is any interest from the Foundation. It sounds like they found the object, immediately knew what it was and locked it up. How did the Foundation find the object? How did they find out its effects? Who took the pictures? Has any testing been done on it? Currently it feels like the author gave a lot of thought to the object but none to its interactions with the world or the worlds interactions with it. Even that last paragraph about its effects on people feels very tacked on. I want to +1 but I can't; no vote

item.content:encoded:
Those who are personnel of the Foundation who have contracted this condition have all been compelled to begin disclosing information about the Foundation to the public.

Perhaps consider revising this sentence. "Personnel who contract this condition have all been compelled to disclose information about the Foundation to the public." Are they only compelled, have there ever been instances that it happened? What does the Foundation do to these people, then? "Terminate" them?

The SCP I like, but I personally don't think that particular symptom - an urge to divulge information to the public - really fits with the rest of the SCP.
